name: NMBS/SNCB

gtfs.attribution: NMBS/SNCB static GTFS via Belgian Mobility open data

rights: Timetable data by NMBS/SNCB (open data). Converted to Linked Connections 2.0-alpha by iRail.
notes: license stays null until the open-data licence IRI of the dataset is confirmed; the converter does not infer legal conditions. regions=1 publishes one connection partition per six-hour bucket (about 260 pages for 65 days); raise it after measuring client scan cost.

measurements.note: Measured locally with gtfs2lc bb4c859; a GitHub-hosted runner must be re-measured. Two such releases (~918 MB) are the most that fit the Pages 1 GB ceiling, so retention is bounded by bytes first.
